label: Rise Above — cinematic roofing
notes: Clean-room donor: identity lives ONLY in src/lib/business.ts as double-brace token literals.
isSet() collapses any element whose token is unset — a blank section is the correct render.
Reviews reduced to ONE tokenised entry; no real reviewer name or text survives.
Gallery/project photos deleted outright — they were the donor's real completed jobs.
hero-sky.mp4 kept: generic golden-hour sky, verified by eye, no business identity.
Unverifiable claims removed (24/7, $0 inspection, 100% photo-documented, family-owned).
Licence stat is gated on {{LICENSE}} — an unverified contractor shows no licence claim.
wordmarkFill is near-white: this donor has a DARK header, where currentColor resolves dark and the mark vanishes.

Footer service links point at /services#<slug>, NOT /services/<slug>: the compiled $service route resolves its own <title> but renders the /services LIST body, so all eight sub-paths were byte-identical pages. The /services page carries id=<slug> on every service article, so the fragment is the destination that actually exists.
